title: Introduction and overview — Land Rover Series I (1948-1958)
description: Introduction and overview of the Land Rover Series I (1948-1958): What this car is, its place in automotive history, and why collectors care. The Land Rover Series I of 1948 was Britain's Jeep: an aluminum-bodied farm 4x4 that became the vehicle of explorers, armies, and safaris worldwide. About 70,000 were built; the Series I's boxy honesty defined Land Rover for 70 years. The 1948 Amsterdam show car launched a legend. Baseline facts: British 4x4 1948-1958; ~70,000 built; aluminum body; explorer and army icon..
